page.overview:
Who is Animal Assistants clerk?

The Animal Assistants clerk is an employee of Animal Assistants. He refused to give Homer Simpson a helper monkey since he is not disabled. Homer brings Abraham Simpson II, pretending that the monkey is for him, and was given Mojo the Helper Monkey as a result.
